senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; old, ancient. Yalk. Chr. 1074 (ref. to I Chr. IV, 22) הדברים הללו מעַתִּיקוֹ של עולם these words come from the Ancient One of the world (v. next w.); v. עָתַק I Hif.—[ (עָתַק I) remote.—Pl. עַתִּיקִים.
units: <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:22">Ib.</cite> (anoth. explan. of I Chr. l. c.) <he>הדברים האלו סתומין כאן וכ׳</he> (not <he>אמורין</he>) these words are obscure here, but explained elsewhere; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:4">s. 2</cite>).]
